canonical_statement: For every pair of natural numbers p and a, if p is prime and a is coprime to p, then a^(p-1) is congruent to 1 modulo p.
domain_and_universes: p a : Nat; Nat.Prime p; Nat.Coprime a p; Nat.ModEq p (a ^ (p - 1)) 1; the closed target is Prop in Lean universe 0.
conclusion: a ^ (p - 1) is congruent to 1 modulo p, encoded as Nat.ModEq p (a ^ (p - 1)) 1.
